Grace — attaching a redline of the MSA and a short comment summary. Highlights / decisions recommended:

- Term / Effective Date: we can agree to 12 months effective 2027-07-01. We'll include a "commencement" clause that ties billing to the first invoice date rather than product traffic to avoid ambiguity.
- SLA credits: propose a capped credit structure (max credits equal to one monthly invoice) and we should decline unlimited credits. That is consistent with precedent.
- Data retention & deletion: push for a 30- to 60-day deletion window after termination, with a carveout for audit records (kept encrypted for 12 months). Ask Quoratech to clarify the exact retention window they need — if they insist on longer retention we should seek higher fees.
- Procurement redlines: there are several boilerplate procurement asks (insurance and indemnity tweaks). I flagged these; recommend we accept standard language but decline any vendor-risk changes that expose us to data residency guarantees.

I've attached: QTR-452_MSA_redline.docx (redline) and a one-page change log called QTR-452_change_log.pdf.

If everyone is comfortable with Marissa's approach, I will finalize the doc and we can send to Elena with the order form.
